messages:
Noah: Major kudos to @tara.dev and @ops-sam 1 they coordinated the surprise care package drop for the LA team and it turned out perfect :sparkling_heart::package:
tara.dev: Team effort! @ops-sam handled the shipping logistics, I handled the snack curation. Glad everyone liked the granola bars. :yum:
ops-sam: Pro tip: label fragile on the plant boxes or the ficus will arrive a bit dramatic. :see_no_evil:
Bea: I got one and it made my week. also thanks for the handwritten note from @Noah 1 tiny gestures go far. :smile:
MailroomBot: Package delivered to "LA Office - Kitchen Shelf" at 14:02, signed by Bea. :package:
Noah: that was me being sneaky. also quick shoutout to the mailroom team for same-day scanning of returns. huge time saver for tradeshow prep.
tara.dev: shall we make this a recurring thing? tiny treats every quarter? react :balloon: for yes, :thinking_face: for maybe, :no_entry: for no.
ops-sam: :balloon: and maybe next time include some gluten-free options. learned that one the hard way.
Bea: +1 GF options. and thank you again, team. small kindnesses = big morale.
Noah: adding to team ritual ideas doc. retro note: "Care package -> morale +1". :notebook: 
MailroomBot: Note: next outgoing parcel pickup window is 10:00am Friday.
ops-sam: I'll coordinate then. thanks everyone :)
